_comment: Project configuration file — edit values below to match your project. All agents, instructions, and prompts read from this file. Run the onboard agent to fill this interactively, or edit directly.

project.name: Improve My Notes App
project.description: A mobile-first, offline-first personal notes app for capturing notes and daily/weekly activities. Notes support rich text, folders, and tags; any note can carry a one-off, daily, or weekly reminder that fires a local push notification — making it work like a lightweight reminder app for recurring routines. All data lives on-device in SQLite (no backend, no account required in v1). Built as a single universal React Native codebase via Expo: on phones navigation uses bottom tabs, on web/wide screens it switches to a persistent side panel.

techStack.frontend: React Native Web (via Expo, web mode is secondary target)
techStack.backend: None (local-only app, no server in v1)

database.dataPattern: Single-user, on-device storage (per-device isolation, no multi-tenancy)
database.caching: None (SQLite on-device is the source of truth)

auth.provider: None (v1 is single local user; auth may be added in a later spec)

ui.designSystem: Custom (NativeWind utility classes + shared design tokens in tailwind.config)

hosting.platform: Expo EAS Build (iOS/Android binaries); Expo web export optional — no server hosting required

patterns: 1. Offline-first: SQLite (expo-sqlite) on-device is the single source of truth; no network layer in v1.
2. Repository pattern: all SQL lives in src/db/repositories/*; UI components never touch the database driver directly.
3. Drizzle ORM schema in src/db/schema.ts with drizzle-kit generated migrations applied on app start.
4. Expo Router file-based routing under src/app/; one universal codebase for iOS, Android, and web.
5. Adaptive navigation: bottom tab bar below the md breakpoint (<768px), persistent side panel at md and above (web/tablet/desktop).
6. Rich text stored as sanitized HTML in notes.body_html plus a derived plain-text column (notes.body_text) kept in sync for search.
7. Full-text search via SQLite FTS5 virtual table, kept in sync with notes through triggers or repository-level writes.
8. Local notifications via expo-notifications; every scheduled notification id is persisted on its reminder row so it can be cancelled/rescheduled deterministically.
9. Soft delete for notes (deleted_at column) with a Trash view; hard delete only from Trash.
10. State: React Query (TanStack Query) over repository functions for cache/invalidation; no global state library unless a spec requires it.
codingStandards: TypeScript strict mode; no `any` unless justified with an inline comment.
Functional components with hooks only; no class components.
Style with NativeWind className utilities; reserve inline style objects for values that must be computed at runtime.
Import via the @/ alias from src/; no deep relative paths (../../..).
Repository functions are fully typed (Drizzle inferred types) and are the only place SQL/query-builder calls appear.
Screens live in src/app/ (Expo Router); reusable UI in src/components/; domain logic in src/lib/.
Inline `// comments` only for non-obvious logic; no block comments or JSDoc unless asked.
Conventional commit prefixes: feat(notes): …, fix(reminders): …, spec(search): …, test(folders): …
securityRules: Parameterized queries only (Drizzle/prepared statements); never interpolate user input into SQL strings.
Sanitize rich-text HTML on save and render inside the editor WebView only; never render note HTML with JavaScript enabled or load remote content from it.
Request notification permission in context (when the user sets their first reminder), with a clear rationale; handle denial gracefully.
No analytics, tracking, or network transmission of note content — the app is local-only in v1.
No secrets in the repository; EAS credentials stay in EAS/GitHub secrets.
Validate all user input at the repository boundary (e.g., non-empty folder names, valid reminder times) before it reaches SQLite.
performanceTargets: Cold start to interactive note list < 2s on a mid-range Android device.
Note list scrolls at 60fps with 1,000+ notes (virtualized list, e.g. FlashList).
Search results render < 200ms for a 10,000-note database (FTS5 index, debounced input).
Editor keystroke latency < 50ms; autosave is debounced and never blocks typing.
All database mutations run off the UI thread (async expo-sqlite API).

fileStructure:
src/
├── app/                      # Expo Router routes (file-based)
│   ├── _layout.tsx           # Root layout: adaptive nav (bottom tabs <768px, side panel ≥768px)
│   ├── (tabs)/               # Tab/panel destinations
│   │   ├── index.tsx         # Notes list (home)
│   │   ├── search.tsx        # Search screen
│   │   ├── reminders.tsx     # Reminders overview
│   │   └── settings.tsx      # Settings
│   ├── note/[id].tsx         # Note editor (create/edit)
│   ├── folder/[id].tsx       # Notes filtered by folder
│   └── trash.tsx             # Soft-deleted notes
├── components/               # Reusable UI (NoteCard, TagChip, ReminderPicker, …)
├── db/
│   ├── schema.ts             # Drizzle schema (notes, folders, tags, note_tags, reminders)
│   ├── migrations/           # drizzle-kit generated migrations
│   └── repositories/         # notesRepo, foldersRepo, tagsRepo, remindersRepo, searchRepo
├── lib/                      # Domain logic (notifications scheduling, html→text, date/recurrence)
├── hooks/                    # React Query hooks wrapping repositories
└── theme/                    # NativeWind tokens, dark/light palettes
__tests__/
├── unit/                     # Jest unit tests (repositories, lib)
├── component/                # React Native Testing Library
└── e2e/                      # Maestro flows (.yml)
